content:
Priya: Heads-up  VerdantCare agreed to a short case study + 30-min webinar. Target publish/webinar week: July 12. Need bench numbers, signed release, and speaker availability.
Jules: I'll ask VerdantCare for a PM + infra engineer to co-present and request a 1-2 line quote. Draft outreach ready.
Ari: Draft hero options: "How VerdantCare scaled inference for clinical triage" (exec) and "Realtime scoring at lower cost: VerdantCare + Redwood" (dev). Will add social variants after numbers.
Dan: Bench plan: Llama2-13b-q4 on representative infra, metrics: median latency, p95, tokens/sec at 6 concurrent streams. Will upload CSV + runbook by Jun 30.
Mei: Legal: no PHI, customer must sign release. Provide anonymization options for cohort sizes. I'll prepare release template and a short redaction checklist.
Rowan: Webinar ops: prefer Zoom Webinar. Need final slides by Jul 5, rehearsal Jul 10. I'll set tentative holds once VerdantCare confirms.
Jules: Outreach sent at 09:12. Liam replied: "We can co-present; legal needs 48h and will likely ask to anonymize cohort counts."
Priya: Action items: Jules outreach (today), Dan bench (due Jun 30), Ari draft (due Jul 3), Mei release template (due Jul 1), Rowan ops (rehearsal hold). React with :white_check_mark: to accept.
Dan: :white_check_mark: I'll add reproducibility snippet to the appendix.
Ari: :white_check_mark:
Mei: :white_check_mark:
Jules: Liam from VerdantCare signed release at 16:05 and selected anonymize counts. Uploading signed copy.
Dan: Uploaded raw bench: https://drive.example/verdant/bench.csv and runbook: https://drive.example/verdant/runbook.md. Warmup=300, batch=4. Please redact cohort_id before publishing.
Mei: Confirmed redaction approach is fine. Jules, please get customer confirmation on removing cohort_id.
Jules: Confirmed with Liam: OK to anonymize counts and remove cohort_id. He approved the quote: "Redwood helped us move to real-time scoring without spikes in cost."
Priya: Great. Once redacted CSV and final slides are in, we'll open registration (T-14) and route leads: Private/Dedicated -> Enterprise AE. leadgen-bot, please create campaign.
leadgen-bot: SFDC campaign suggested: verdant-case-july12. Routing rule applied: Private/Dedicated -> Enterprise AE; utm_campaign=verdant-case.
Rowan: Calendar hold created: "VerdantCare: Case + Webinar" Jul 12 10:00 PT  https://calendar.example/e/verdant-712. Rehearsal slot Jul 10 11:00 PT.
Ari: Draft blog + slides pushed to docs: https://docs.example/verdant-draft — awaiting final bench link.
Priya: Closing checklist: signed release (done), redacted CSV (pending), slides (due Jul 5), registration live (planned Jun 28). Flag blockers here.
Jules: Redacted CSV uploaded: https://drive.example/verdant/bench_redacted.csv. All good from customer.
Mei: Legal signoff complete.
Dan: :rocket: Ready to publish methodology appendix after final QA.
Priya: :rocket: Thanks team. If anything slips, ping me and I'll escalate to CSM.
